responsibility: Builds the standalone generator that emits per-MCU GCC spec files (`specs-<mcu>`) from the AVR device tables and configured library/toolchain features. It reads the canonical architecture/device metadata from `avr-devices.cc` and combines it with `specs.h`, optional AVR-LibC configuration, assembler/linker capability macros, and floating-type multilib settings to produce device-specific driver fragments controlling cc1, assembler, linker, cpp, startfiles, device libraries, memory origins, and MCU-implied options.
